import json, urllib.request, urllib.error; BASE='http://127.0.0.1:8080'; HOST='Bearer lifestream-local-dev-token'; COLLAB='Bearer lifestream-local-collaborator-token';

def req(path, method='GET', token=None, body=None):
    headers={}
    if token: headers['Authorization']=token
    data=None
    if body is not None:
        data=json.dumps(body).encode(); headers['Content-Type']='application/json'
    request=urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=data, headers=headers, method=method)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as resp:
            raw=resp.read().decode(); return resp.status, json.loads(raw) if raw else None
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        raw=exc.read().decode(); return exc.code, json.loads(raw) if raw else None

created=req('/api/v1/creator/me/live/collabs/sessions','POST',HOST,{'broadcastId':'bcast-now','title':'fozzy collab session','chatMode':'shared','recordingPolicy':'host_archive'})
assert created[0] == 200, created
sid=created[1]['id']
assert created[1]['lastEventSeq'] == 1, created
invite=req(f'/api/v1/creator/me/live/collabs/sessions/{sid}/invites','POST',HOST,{'inviteeUserId':'usr-2','role':'co_streamer','mirrorToGuestChannel':True,'message':'join from fozzy','expiresInMinutes':30})
assert invite[0] == 200 and invite[1]['state'] == 'pending', invite
iid=invite[1]['id']
host_events=req(f'/api/v1/creator/me/live/collabs/sessions/{sid}/events','GET',HOST)
assert host_events[0] == 200 and [e['eventType'] for e in host_events[1]][:2] == ['session_created','invite_created'], host_events
inbox=req('/api/v1/me/live/collabs/invites','GET',COLLAB)
assert inbox[0] == 200 and any(item['id'] == iid for item in inbox[1]), inbox
accepted=req(f'/api/v1/live/collabs/invites/{iid}/accept','POST',COLLAB)
assert accepted[0] == 200 and accepted[1]['state'] == 'backstage', accepted
pid=accepted[1]['id']
participant_list=req('/api/v1/me/live/collabs/sessions','GET',COLLAB)
assert participant_list[0] == 200 and any(item['id'] == sid for item in participant_list[1]), participant_list
participant_view=req(f'/api/v1/me/live/collabs/sessions/{sid}','GET',COLLAB)
assert participant_view[0] == 200 and participant_view[1]['participant']['id'] == pid and 'invites' not in participant_view[1], participant_view
participant_events=req(f'/api/v1/me/live/collabs/sessions/{sid}/events?afterSeq=1','GET',COLLAB)
assert participant_events[0] == 200 and any(e['eventType'] == 'invite_accepted' for e in participant_events[1]), participant_events
updated=req(f'/api/v1/creator/me/live/collabs/sessions/{sid}/participants/{pid}','PATCH',HOST,{'state':'live','mirrorToGuestChannel':True,'publishToHost':True,'canSpeakInChat':True})
assert updated[0] == 200 and updated[1]['state'] == 'live', updated
grant=req(f'/api/v1/creator/me/live/collabs/sessions/{sid}/participants/{pid}/grants/mirror','POST',HOST)
assert grant[0] == 200 and grant[1]['state'] == 'issued' and grant[1]['guestCreatorId'] == 'crt-atlas', grant
grant_list=req(f'/api/v1/me/live/collabs/sessions/{sid}/grants','GET',COLLAB)
assert grant_list[0] == 200 and any(item['id'] == grant[1]['id'] for item in grant_list[1]), grant_list
redeemed=req(f"/api/v1/live/collabs/grants/{grant[1]['id']}/redeem",'POST',COLLAB)
assert redeemed[0] == 200 and redeemed[1]['state'] == 'active', redeemed
dupe=req(f'/api/v1/live/collabs/invites/{iid}/accept','POST',COLLAB)
assert dupe[0] == 400 and 'no longer pending' in dupe[1]['error'], dupe
left=req(f'/api/v1/me/live/collabs/sessions/{sid}/leave','POST',COLLAB)
assert left[0] == 200 and left[1]['state'] == 'left', left
host_after_leave=req(f'/api/v1/creator/me/live/collabs/sessions/{sid}','GET',HOST)
assert host_after_leave[0] == 200 and any(item['id'] == pid and item['state'] == 'left' for item in host_after_leave[1]['participants']), host_after_leave
final_events=req(f'/api/v1/creator/me/live/collabs/sessions/{sid}/events','GET',HOST)
assert final_events[0] == 200 and any(e['eventType'] == 'mirror_grant_redeemed' for e in final_events[1]) and any(e['eventType'] == 'participant_left' for e in final_events[1]), final_events
ended=req(f'/api/v1/creator/me/live/collabs/sessions/{sid}/end','POST',HOST)
assert ended[0] == 200 and ended[1]['status'] == 'ended', ended
print('collaboration-session-graph-pass')
